Grounded ammo-case construction: compact squat rectangular olive painted-steel shell, broad quiet panels, angular clipped corners, two simple front toggle latches, sturdy integrated recessed top carry handle folded flush, a few broad reinforcing ribs. Faceted low-poly world style, crisp planar bevels, hard face normals, solid flat colour fields, no texture noise, no rust, no dirt, no photorealistic finish. Single object only, no loose cartridges, no hands, no weapons, no props, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no arrows, no dimensions, no diagram, no multi-view sheet. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D tactical FPS HUD heal icon concept for BattleDuty-aimbot. Create exactly one original flat icon on a genuinely transparent background, centered with generous transparent padding, straight-on orthographic view. Match a restrained CoD/Battlefield-like HUD layer that uses Rajdhani condensed typography, crisp flat weapon silhouettes, near-black contrast edges, white and amber highlights; this symbol itself has no typography. A bold mint-green medical cross drawn as a deliberate geometric asset with equal arms and clipped outer corners, nested inside a compact thin angular open shield outline. Clear negative space between cross and shield. The cross is the primary read for the medic heal aura, the shield supports its overhealth badge meaning. Keep simple enough to remain readable at 24-32 pixels: thick cross arms, no microdetail, no gradients, no glossy effects, no 3D bevels. Near-black narrow keyline around the green silhouette for contrast over light or dark game scenery. Clean vector-like edges, flat colour mint green approximately #9EFFA8 and charcoal #14191F only. One unified symbol only, not a font plus glyph, no separate floating effects, no icon sheet, no variations, no lettering, no numerals, no watermark, no background panel. Intended concept for a rising/fading heal sprite and steady badge using the same art. Original design.
